  - Eliminates race conditions during initialization
  
+ ## User Interaction Model
+ 
+ The navigation system implements a clear user interaction model:
+ 
+ 1. **Location Selection vs. Map Navigation**
+    - Clicking on the map selects a location without centering the map
+    - Clicking search results selects the location without centering the map
+    - Pressing Enter in the search field searches and centers the map on the selected location
+    - Using the compass button in the Nearby Meetups panel centers the map on user's location
+ 
+ 2. **Reverse Geocoding on Map Click**
+    - When a user clicks the map, reverse geocoding is performed to get the address
+    - The location field is updated with the address or place name
+    - A loading indicator appears during the geocoding process
+ 
+ 3. **Search Functionality**
+    - Search suggestions appear as the user types
+    - Clicking a suggestion selects it without moving the map
+    - Pressing Enter performs the search and centers the map on the result
+ 
  ## MapNavigationController
  
    }
  }, [location]);
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Implementing the User Interaction Model
+ 
+ #### Map Click Handling
+ 
+ ```jsx
+ // MapClickHandler component
+ const MapClickHandler = ({ onLocationSelect }) => {
+   const map = useMap();
+   
+   const handleClick = async (e) => {
+     const { lat, lng } = e.latlng;
+     
+     // Provide immediate feedback with a temporary label
+     const tempLocation = {
+       lat,
+       lng,
+       display_name: "Finding location..."
+     };
+     
+     // Select the location without centering the map
+     onLocationSelect(tempLocation);
+     
+     // Show loading indicator for reverse geocoding
+     setIsReverseGeocoding(true);
+     
+     try {
+       // Fetch the actual address using reverse geocoding
+       const results = await searchLocations(null, { lat, lng });
+       
+       if (results && results.length > 0) {
+         const result = results[0];
+         // Determine the best display name (place name or address)
+         let displayName = determineDisplayName(result);
+         
+         // Update the search address field with the place name
+         setSearchAddress(displayName);
+         
+         // Update with the place name or address
+         const locationWithAddress = {
+           ...result,
+           lat,
+           lng,
+           display_name: displayName
+         };
+         onLocationSelect(locationWithAddress);
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Error reverse geocoding:', error);
+       onLocationSelect({
+         lat,
+         lng,
+         display_name: "Unable to find address"
+       });
+     } finally {
+       setIsReverseGeocoding(false);
+     }
+   };
+   
+   useEffect(() => {
+     map.on('click', handleClick);
+     return () => {
+       map.off('click', handleClick);
+     };
+   }, [map, handleClick]);
+   
+   return null;
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Search Suggestion Handling
+ 
+ ```jsx
+ // Handle search suggestion click
+ <div 
+   className="search-suggestion"
+   onClick={() => {
+     // Update the selected location without centering the map
+     handleLocationSelect(result);
+     // Update the search field with the selected location name
+     setSearchAddress(result.display_name || '');
+     // Clear search results
+     setSearchResults([]);
+   }}
+ >
+   {result.display_name}
+ </div>
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Enter Key Handling
+ 
+ ```jsx
+ // Handle Enter key press in search field
+ onKeyDown={(e) => {
+   if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+     e.stopPropagation();
+     e.preventDefault();
+     
+     if (isSearching) return;
+     
+     setIsSearching(true);
+     
+     // Search for location
+     searchLocations(searchAddress.trim())
+       .then(results => {
+         setSearchResults(results || []);
+         
+         if (results && results.length > 0) {
+           const result = results[0];
+           
+           // Update the selected location
+           setSelectedLocation(result);
+           
+           // Update the search field
+           setSearchAddress(result.display_name || '');
+           
+           // Clear search results
+           setSearchResults([]);
+           
+           // Update the controller's selected location
+           if (navigationController.current) {
+             navigationController.current.setSelectedLocation(result);
+             
+             // Since Enter was pressed, center the map
+             navigationController.current.navigateTo({
+               lat: result.lat,
+               lng: result.lng
+             }, {
+               zoom: 16,
+               animate: true
+             });
+           }
+         }
+       })
+       .finally(() => {
+         setIsSearching(false);
+       });
+   }
+ }}
+ ```
+ 
+ #### "Center on User" Button
+ 
+ ```jsx
+ // Button to center map on user location
+ <button 
+   onClick={() => {
+     if (navigationController.current && location) {
+       navigationController.current.navigateTo({
+         lat: location.lat,
+         lng: location.lng
+       }, {
+         zoom: 21, // High zoom level for detailed view
+         animate: true
+       });
+     }
+   }}
+   className="compass-button"
+   title="Center map on your location"
+ >
+   <FaCompass />
+ </button>
  ```
  
  ## Best Practices
  
- 1. **Prevent Multiple Initializations**
+ 1. **Separate Location Selection from Map Navigation**
+    ```js
+    // Just update the selected location (no map movement)
+    navigationController.setSelectedLocation(location);
+    
+    // Move the map to a location (with map movement)
+    navigationController.navigateTo(location, { zoom: 16, animate: true });
+    ```
+ 
+ 2. **Prevent Multiple Initializations**
     ```js

+ ## Key Features
+ 
+ 1. **Intuitive Map Navigation**
+    - Map click location selection with reverse geocoding
+    - Search functionality with suggestions
+    - Clear separation between selecting locations and map navigation
+    - "Center on User" button in the Nearby Meetups panel
+ 
+ 2. **Real-time Meetup Information**
+    - Distance from user
+    - Live expiration countdown with animation
+    - Click to navigate to meetup location
+ 
+ 3. **Responsive User Interface**
+    - Context-aware loading states
+    - Error recovery mechanisms

+ 
  ## Getting Started with Development
  
  
  1. Maintain the separation between user location and selected location
- 2. Use the vicinity-focused navigation approach for map interactions
+ 2. Use the navigation controller for all map interactions
  3. Follow the existing code style and conventions
  4. Test all changes thoroughly in different browsers and devices
  5. Update documentation when adding/changing significant functionality
  6. Always ensure navigation operations are properly error-handled
- 7. For navigation operations, check `navigationController.isReadyToNavigate()` before performing them 
+ 7. Respect the user interaction model:
+    - Map clicks select location without centering the map
+    - Enter key in search centers the map on the selected location
+    - Clicking search results selects the location without centering the map
+ 8. Always use the standard location format `{lat, lng}` throughout the application

After analyzing the code in both files, I can see the fundamental issue with the MapClickHandler integration. Here's my perspective:

## The Core Problem

The problem isn't just in the implementation details - it's a **structural misalignment** between how React components like MapClickHandler work and how the class-based MapNavigationController operates:

1. **Event Registration Timing**: The controller is registering map click events in `updateMapReference()`, but this might be happening at a different time than when React would normally set up its event listeners.

2. **Duplicate Event Handlers**: Both the React component and the controller are trying to attach click handlers to the same map, causing duplicate handling.

3. **Lifecycle Synchronization**: React's component lifecycle isn't synchronized with the controller's initialization and update cycles.

## The Solution Approach

Instead of trying to move the MapClickHandler component into the controller, I recommend a different approach:

1. **Let the controller handle all map events exclusively**
2. **Use proper event cleanup in the controller**
3. **Make the controller the single source of truth**

Here's how I would implement it:

```javascript
// In MeetNowApp.jsx:
useEffect(() => {
  // Initialize the controller with ALL required callbacks
  navigationController.current = new MapNavigationController({
    // Map events
    onMapReady: (map) => {
      mapRef.current = map;
      setIsMapReady(true);
      mapInitialized.current = true;
    },
    
    // Click handling 
    onMapClick: (clickedLocation) => {
      // Just pass the raw coordinates - controller will handle geocoding
      console.log('Map clicked at:', clickedLocation);
    },
    
    // Results handling
    onLocationSelect: (location) => {
      // This gets called with the fully processed location (after geocoding)
      handleLocationSelect(location);
    },
    
    // UI state 
    onReverseGeocodingStart: () => setIsReverseGeocoding(true),
    onReverseGeocodingEnd: () => setIsReverseGeocoding(false),
    onSearchAddressUpdate: setSearchAddress,
    
    // Error handling
    onError: (error) => console.error('Navigation controller error:', error)
  });
}, []);

// In MapContainer:
// REMOVE the MapClickHandler component entirely
```

In the MapNavigationController, you'd have something like:

```javascript
// In MapNavigationController.js
_setupMapClickHandler() {
  if (!this._mapInstance) return;
  
  // Clean up previous handler if it exists
  if (this._mapClickHandler) {
    this._mapInstance.off('click', this._mapClickHandler);
  }
  
  // Create a fresh handler with proper binding
  this._mapClickHandler = this._handleMapClick.bind(this);
  this._mapInstance.on('click', this._mapClickHandler);
  
  console.log('Map click handler set up successfully');
}

async _handleMapClick(e) {
  const { lat, lng } = e.latlng;
  
  // Report the raw click first - useful for logging
  if (this.onMapClick) this.onMapClick({ lat, lng });
  
  // Show temporary marker/state
  const tempLocation = { lat, lng, display_name: "Finding location..." };
  if (this.onLocationSelect) this.onLocationSelect(tempLocation);
  
  // Start geocoding process
  this._isReverseGeocoding = true;
  if (this.onReverseGeocodingStart) this.onReverseGeocodingStart();
  
  try {
    // Perform geocoding
    const results = await searchLocations(null, { lat, lng });
    
    if (results?.length > 0) {
      const result = results[0];
      const displayName = this._determineDisplayName(result);
      
      // Update address field
      if (this.onSearchAddressUpdate) this.onSearchAddressUpdate(displayName);
      
      // Create complete location with all necessary data
      const completeLocation = {
        ...result,
        lat, lng,
        display_name: displayName
      };
      
      // Update selected location internally
      this.setSelectedLocation(completeLocation);
      
      // Notify app
      if (this.onLocationSelect) this.onLocationSelect(completeLocation);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Geocoding error:', error);
    
    if (this.onError) this.onError(error);
    
    // Provide fallback location
    const errorLocation = { lat, lng, display_name: "Unable to find address" };
    if (this.onLocationSelect) this.onLocationSelect(errorLocation);
  } finally {
    this._isReverseGeocoding = false;
    if (this.onReverseGeocodingEnd) this.onReverseGeocodingEnd();
  }
}
```

## What's Likely Happening

When you call `updateMapReference` with the map object in `handleMapReady`, the controller might be:
1. Not properly registering the click handler
2. Or it's registering it, but then another handler is also being registered
3. Or the event listeners are not being properly removed when components unmount

This creates a race condition, and it's showing up as the `mapclickkahandler keep repeating in a loop in the console` - because every time the controller gets a map reference, it tries to set up a handler that's then competing with the React component's handler.

+   /**
+    * Handle map clicks with reverse geocoding
+    * @private

+   async _handleMapClick(e) {
+     const { lat, lng } = e.latlng;

+     // Provide immediate feedback with a temporary label
+     const tempLocation = {
+       lat,
+       lng,

+     };
+     
+     // Notify location selection (without centering)
+     if (this.onLocationSelect && typeof this.onLocationSelect === 'function') {
+       this.onLocationSelect(tempLocation);
+     }
+     
+     // Update our internal selected location
+     this.setSelectedLocation(tempLocation);
+     
+     // Notify that reverse geocoding is starting
+     this._isReverseGeocoding = true;
+     if (this.onReverseGeocodingStart && typeof this.onReverseGeocodingStart === 'function') {

+     }
+     
+     try {
+       // Fetch the actual address using reverse geocoding
+       const results = await searchLocations(null, { lat, lng });
+       
+       if (results && results.length > 0) {
+         const result = results[0];
+         
+         // Determine the best display name (place name or address)
+         let displayName = this._determineDisplayName(result);
+         
+         // Update the search address field with the display name
+         if (this.onSearchAddressUpdate && typeof this.onSearchAddressUpdate === 'function') {
+           this.onSearchAddressUpdate(displayName);
+         }
+         
+         // Create the location with the display name
+         const locationWithAddress = {
+           ...result,
+           lat,
+           lng,
+           display_name: displayName
+         };
+         
+         // Update our internal selected location
+         this.setSelectedLocation(locationWithAddress);
+         
+         // Notify with the location and display name
+         if (this.onLocationSelect && typeof this.onLocationSelect === 'function') {
+           this.onLocationSelect(locationWithAddress);
+         }
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       Logger.error(this.TAG, 'Error reverse geocoding:', error);
+       
+       // Create an error location
+       const errorLocation = {
+         lat,
+         lng,
+         display_name: "Unable to find address"
+       };
+       
+       // Update our internal selected location
+       this.setSelectedLocation(errorLocation);
+       
+       // Notify with the error location

+       }
+       
+       // Call error callback if provided
+       if (this.onError && typeof this.onError === 'function') {

+     } finally {

+       this._isReverseGeocoding = false;
+       if (this.onReverseGeocodingEnd && typeof this.onReverseGeocodingEnd === 'function') {

+       }
+     }

+   /**
+    * Determine the best display name from geocoding result
+    * @private
+    * @param {Object} result - The geocoding result
+    * @returns {string} The display name
+    */
+   _determineDisplayName(result) {
+     // By default, use the full address
+     let displayName = result.display_name;
+     
+     // Try to find a place name to prioritize
+     if (result.name) {
+       // Direct name property - use this if available
+       displayName = result.name;
+     } else if (result.tags && result.tags.name) {
+       // OSM tags may have a name
+       displayName = result.tags.name;
+     } else if (result.address) {
+       const address = result.address;

+       // Try to find the most specific name (from most to least specific)

+                       address.tourism ||
+                       address.shop ||
+                       address.historic || 
+                       address.natural ||
+                       address.office ||
+                       address.healthcare || 
+                       address.place_of_worship;
+       
+       // If a specific place name was found, use it
+       if (placeName) {
+         displayName = placeName;
+       }
+     }
+     
+     return displayName;
+   }

- # MeetNow Navigation System Documentation

- ## Overview

+ The MeetNow navigation system has been completely simplified, removing all mode-based navigation. The system now focuses on basic map navigation with a clean, straightforward API for map control. This document explains the current approach, implementation details, and guidelines for working with the map navigation.
  
- ## Navigation Philosophy
- 
- ### Simplified Single-Responsibility Approach
- 
- The navigation system now follows a simpler, more focused approach:
- - **Direct Map Control** - Clear API for map movement and location tracking
- - **Consistent Behavior** - Standardized patterns for all navigation tasks
- - **Robust Error Handling** - Improved validation and recovery mechanisms
- - **Clear Initialization** - Streamlined setup process with less redundancy
- 
- This simplified approach:
- - Reduces code complexity and potential bugs
- - Makes the codebase more maintainable
- - Provides a more consistent user experience
- - Eliminates race conditions during initialization
- 
- ## MapNavigationController
- 
- The `MapNavigationController` class is the core of the navigation system, providing methods to control the map view and handle navigation events.
+ ## Key Features
+ 
+ - **Simple Map Navigation**: Direct map control without complex navigation modes
+ - **Location Management**: Track and update user and selected locations
+ - **Map Click Handling**: Built-in reverse geocoding for map click interactions
+ - **Centralized API**: All map operations managed through a single controller
+ 
+ ## Implementation
+ 
+ The navigation system is centered around the `MapNavigationController` class, which provides a consistent interface for all map interactions.
  
- ### Key Components
+ ### Core Components
  
- 1. **Initialization and Configuration**
-    - Options for default zoom and animation preferences
-    - Support for callbacks (location updates, ready state, errors)
- 
- 2. **Location Management**
-    - Setting and retrieving user location
-    - Setting and retrieving selected locations
-    - Format normalization between different location formats
- 
- 3. **Map Reference Handling**
-    - Support for various map reference types (direct instance, React ref)
-    - Robust extraction of the map instance
-    - Improved validation of map references
- 
- 4. **Navigation Operations**
-    - Navigation to arbitrary locations
-    - Center on user location
-    - Map bounds and zoom control
- 
- 5. **Error Handling**
-    - Enhanced input validation
-    - Graceful fallbacks
-    - Detailed logging for troubleshooting
- 
- ### Initialization
- 
- The controller should be initialized once in the main component that contains the map:
+ 1. **MapNavigationController**: Central controller for map operations
+ 2. **MapClickHandlerWithController**: React component that connects the React-Leaflet map to the controller
+ 
+ ### Key Methods
+ 
+ - `navigateTo(location, options)`: Navigate the map to a specific location
+ - `centerOnUser(options)`: Center the map on the user's current location
+ - `setSelectedLocation(location)`: Update the selected location
+ - `setUserLocation(location)`: Update the user's location
+ 
+ ## Integration with React Components
+ 
+ The controller can be used with React through a reference:
  
  ```jsx

  const navigationController = useRef(null);
  
+ // Initialize on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    navigationController.current = new MapNavigationController({
-     defaultZoom: 15,
-     onReady: (success) => {
-       console.log(`Navigation controller ready: ${success}`);
-     },
-     onLocationChange: (location) => {
-       console.log('Location changed:', location);
-     },
-     onError: (error) => {
-       console.error('Navigation controller error:', error);
-     }
+     onLocationSelect: handleLocationSelect,
+     // Other callbacks...
    });
    
  ```
  
- ### Map Reference Setup
- 
- The controller uses a single-initialization pattern to prevent redundant calls:
- 
- ```jsx
- // Track if initialization already happened
- const mapInitialized = useRef(false);
- 
- // In the map ready handler
- const handleMapReady = useCallback((map) => {
-   // Guard against multiple initializations
-   if (mapInitialized.current) {
-     console.log('Map already initialized, skipping');
-     return;
-   }
-   
-   console.log('Map is ready now');
-   mapRef.current = map;
-   mapInitialized.current = true;
-   
-   // Update the controller with the map instance
-   if (navigationController.current) {
-     navigationController.current.updateMapReference(map);
-     
-     // Center map on user location if available
-     if (location) {
-       navigationController.current.navigateTo({
-         lat: location.lat,
-         lng: location.lng
-       }, {
-         zoom: 17,
-         animate: true
-       });
-     }
-   }
- }, [navigationController, location]);
- ```
- 
- ### Location Updates
- 
- The controller should be updated when user location changes:
- 
- ```jsx
- // When user location updates
- useEffect(() => {
-   // Skip if no valid location or map not yet initialized
-   if (!location || !mapInitialized.current) return;
-   
-   if (navigationController.current) {
-     // Pass location using consistent lat/lng format
-     navigationController.current.setUserLocation(location);
-   }
- }, [location]);
- ```
- 
- ### Cleanup
- 
- Dispose of the controller when the component unmounts:
- 
- ```jsx
- useEffect(() => {
-   // Initialization...
-   
-   return () => {
-     if (navigationController.current) {
-       navigationController.current.dispose();
-     }
-   };
- }, []);
- ```
- 
- ## Error Handling Improvements
- 
- The navigation system includes several error handling improvements:
- 
- 1. **Input Validation**
-    - Enhanced checks for null/undefined locations
-    - Validation of coordinate values and types
-    - Normalization of different location formats
- 
- 2. **Map Reference Validation**
-    - Comprehensive type checking of map reference
-    - Support for both direct map instances and React refs
-    - Clear logging of map reference issues
- 
- 3. **Promise-Based API**
-    - Navigation operations return promises
-    - Errors are properly captured and handled
-    - Success/failure states are clearly communicated
- 
- 4. **Robust Logging**
-    - Detailed logging at each critical step
-    - Clear differentiation between warning and error states
-    - Helpful context for troubleshooting
- 
- ## Debugging
- 
- For troubleshooting navigation issues:
- 
- 1. **Check Console Logs**
-    - The controller logs detailed information about its operations
-    - Errors and warnings are clearly marked
-    - Each operation is prefixed with identifying tags
- 
- 2. **Common Issues**
-    - Map not ready when trying to navigate
-    - Invalid location format
-    - Race conditions during initialization
-    - Multiple initialization attempts
- 
- 3. **Verification Steps**
-    - Confirm the map instance is properly extracted
-    - Verify locations have valid lat/lng values
-    - Check initialization sequence for redundant calls
- 
- ## Performance Considerations
- 
- The simplified approach offers several performance benefits:
- 
- 1. **Reduced State Complexity**
-    - Simpler state management
-    - Fewer edge cases to handle
- 
- 2. **Optimized Map Operations**
-    - Clear, direct map control
-    - Prevention of redundant operations
- 
- 3. **Single Initialization Pattern**
-    - Prevents multiple initialization attempts
-    - Guards against race conditions
- 
  ## Best Practices
  
- 1. **Prevent Multiple Initializations**
-    ```js
-    // Track initialization state
-    const mapInitialized = useRef(false);
-    
-    // Guard against redundant initialization
-    if (mapInitialized.current) return;
-    ```
- 
- 2. **Handle Promise Rejections**
-    ```js
-    navigationController.navigateTo(location)
-      .then(success => {
-        // Handle success
-      })
-      .catch(error => {
-        // Handle error
-      });
-    ```
- 
- 3. **Validate Locations**
-    ```js
-    // The controller now handles different location formats internally
-    // Both of these formats work:
-    navigationController.setUserLocation({
-      lat: 37.7749,
-      lng: -122.4194
-    });
-    
-    navigationController.setUserLocation({
-      latitude: 37.7749,
-      longitude: -122.4194
-    });
-    ```
- 
- 4. **Provide Cleanup**
-    ```js

-    navigationController.dispose();
-    ```
- 
- ## Location Format Normalization
- 
- The controller now automatically normalizes different location formats:
- 
- ```javascript
- // All of these formats are accepted:
- {
-   lat: 37.7749,
-   lng: -122.4194
- }
- 
- {
-   latitude: 37.7749,
-   longitude: -122.4194
- }
- 
- [37.7749, -122.4194]  // Array format
- ```
- 
- ### Format Guidelines
- 
- - Internally, the controller normalizes to `{lat, lng}` format
- - When providing locations to controller methods, any of the above formats work
- - Coordinates are always converted to numbers if provided as strings
- 
- ## Controller API
- 
- ### Initialization
- 
- ```javascript
- const controller = new MapNavigationController({
-   defaultZoom: 15,  // Default zoom level for navigation
-   animateTransitions: true,  // Whether to animate map movements
-   onReady: (success) => {},  // Called when controller is ready
-   onLocationChange: (location) => {},  // Called when user location changes
-   onError: (error) => {}  // Called when errors occur
- });
- ```
- 
- ### Core Methods
- 
- ```javascript

- 
- // Set a selected location (destination, point of interest, etc.)
- controller.setSelectedLocation(location);

- 
- // Clean up resources
- controller.dispose();
- ```

- ## Conclusion
- 
- The simplified navigation system provides a more consistent, reliable approach to map control while reducing code complexity and potential bugs. By focusing on core navigation tasks with a clean API, we ensure that users have a smoother experience while developers have a more maintainable codebase. 
+ 1. Always dispose of the controller when the component unmounts
+ 2. Use the controller's methods rather than direct map manipulation
+ 3. Handle controller events through the provided callbacks
+ 4. Ensure the map reference is properly passed to the controller
+ 
+ ## Error Handling
+ 
+ The controller includes robust error handling and logging. Key error scenarios:
+ 
+ - Invalid map reference
+ - Invalid location formats
+ - Navigation attempts before the map is ready
+ - Map click handling failures
+ 
+ ## Future Improvements

  ## Troubleshooting Notes
  
  Common issues and solutions:
  
- 1. **Callback Chain Broken**: If a component fails to call the original callback, the chain breaks
-    - Solution: Always maintain the callback chain pattern shown above
+ 1. **Callback Errors**: If callbacks are not being called or throwing errors
+    - Solution: Ensure all callback properties are properly defined functions
+    - Solution: Check for undefined checking before calling callbacks
  
  2. **Map Reference Issues**: When map references are null or undefined unexpectedly
     - Solution: Use `isReadyToNavigate()` to check before performing operations
-    - Solution: Implement retry with `waitUntilReady()` for critical operations
- 
- 3. **Race Conditions**: When multiple components try to set navigation modes simultaneously
-    - Solution: Use the controller as the single source of truth for mode state
-    - Solution: Implement debouncing for rapid mode changes
+    - Solution: Ensure the map instance is properly passed to `updateMapReference`
+ 
+ 3. **Click Handling Issues**: When map clicks don't trigger the expected behavior
+    - Solution: Verify `MapClickHandlerWithController` is properly included in the MapContainer
+    - Solution: Check that onLocationSelect callback is provided and working
+    - Solution: Monitor the console for any errors during the click/geocoding process

+   const calculateDistance = (lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) => {
+     if (!lat1 || !lon1 || !lat2 || !lon2) return null;
+     
+     const R = 6371e3; // Earth's radius in meters
+     const φ1 = lat1 * Math.PI/180;
+     const φ2 = lat2 * Math.PI/180;
+     const Δφ = (lat2-lat1) * Math.PI/180;
+     const Δλ = (lon2-lon1) * Math.PI/180;
+ 
+     const a = Math.sin(Δφ/2) * Math.sin(Δφ/2) +
+             Math.cos(φ1) * Math.cos(φ2) *
+             Math.sin(Δλ/2) * Math.sin(Δλ/2);
+     const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1-a));
+     
+     return R * c; // Distance in meters
+   };

Now I have a better understanding of how images are currently handled. Let's create a plan to set up Wasabi storage for the application:

Here's how to set up a Wasabi image bucket for the MeetNow app:

1. First, sign up for a Wasabi account at https://wasabi.com/

2. Create a new bucket in Wasabi:
   - Log in to your Wasabi account
   - Click "Create Bucket"
   - Name it "meetnow-images" (or your preferred name)
   - Select the region closest to your users
   - Choose "Private" for bucket access policy

3. Create access credentials:
   - In Wasabi dashboard, go to "Access Keys"
   - Click "Create New Access Key"
   - Save your Access Key and Secret Key securely

4. Now, let's create a configuration file for Wasabi storage:

---

```diff
- 
+ import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand, GetObjectCommand, DeleteObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
+ import { getSignedUrl } from '@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner';
+ import { checkEnvironment } from './env-check';
+ 
+ // Check environment variables
+ checkEnvironment();
+ 
+ // Wasabi configuration
+ const wasabiConfig = {
+   region: import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_REGION || process.env.VITE_WASABI_REGION || 'us-east-1',
+   endpoint: import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_ENDPOINT || process.env.VITE_WASABI_ENDPOINT,
+   bucketName: import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_BUCKET_NAME || process.env.VITE_WASABI_BUCKET_NAME || 'meetnow-images',
+   accessKeyId: import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_ACCESS_KEY_ID || process.env.VITE_WASABI_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
+   secretAccessKey: import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || process.env.VITE_WASABI_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
+ };
+ 
+ // Validate required configuration
+ const validateConfig = () => {
+   const missingVars = [];
+   
+   if (!wasabiConfig.endpoint) missingVars.push('VITE_WASABI_ENDPOINT');
+   if (!wasabiConfig.accessKeyId) missingVars.push('VITE_WASABI_ACCESS_KEY_ID');
+   if (!wasabiConfig.secretAccessKey) missingVars.push('VITE_WASABI_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
+   
+   if (missingVars.length > 0) {
+     console.error(`Missing required Wasabi configuration: ${missingVars.join(', ')}`);
+     return false;
+   }
+   
+   return true;
+ };
+ 
+ // Create S3 client for Wasabi
+ const createWasabiClient = () => {
+   if (!validateConfig()) {
+     console.error('Wasabi configuration is invalid or incomplete');
+     return null;
+   }
+   
+   return new S3Client({
+     region: wasabiConfig.region,
+     endpoint: wasabiConfig.endpoint,
+     credentials: {
+       accessKeyId: wasabiConfig.accessKeyId,
+       secretAccessKey: wasabiConfig.secretAccessKey,
+     },
+     forcePathStyle: true, // Required for Wasabi
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ // Initialize client
+ const wasabiClient = createWasabiClient();
+ 
+ /**
+  * Upload a file to Wasabi
+  * @param {File} file - The file to upload
+  * @param {string} path - The path/key in the bucket (e.g., 'meetups/image1.jpg')
+  * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, url: string|null, error: Error|null}>}
+  */
+ export const uploadFile = async (file, path) => {
+   if (!wasabiClient) {
+     return { success: false, url: null, error: new Error('Wasabi client not initialized') };
+   }
+   
+   try {
+     // Generate a unique filename if path not provided
+     if (!path) {
+       const timestamp = Date.now();
+       const extension = file.name.split('.').pop();
+       path = `meetups/meetup_${timestamp}.${extension}`;
+     }
+     
+     // Prepare upload command
+     const command = new PutObjectCommand({
+       Bucket: wasabiConfig.bucketName,
+       Key: path,
+       Body: file,
+       ContentType: file.type,
+       ACL: 'public-read', // Make the file publicly accessible
+     });
+     
+     // Execute the upload
+     await wasabiClient.send(command);
+     
+     // Generate the public URL
+     const url = `https://${wasabiConfig.bucketName}.${wasabiConfig.endpoint.replace('https://', '')}/${path}`;
+     
+     return { success: true, url, error: null };
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error uploading file to Wasabi:', error);
+     return { success: false, url: null, error };
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Generate a signed URL for temporary access to a private file
+  * @param {string} path - The path/key in the bucket
+  * @param {number} expiresIn - Expiration time in seconds (default: 3600)
+  * @returns {Promise<string|null>} - The signed URL or null if error
+  */
+ export const getSignedFileUrl = async (path, expiresIn = 3600) => {
+   if (!wasabiClient) {
+     console.error('Wasabi client not initialized');
+     return null;
+   }
+   
+   try {
+     const command = new GetObjectCommand({
+       Bucket: wasabiConfig.bucketName,
+       Key: path,
+     });
+     
+     return await getSignedUrl(wasabiClient, command, { expiresIn });
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error generating signed URL:', error);
+     return null;
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Delete a file from Wasabi
+  * @param {string} path - The path/key in the bucket
+  * @returns {Promise<boolean>} - Success status
+  */
+ export const deleteFile = async (path) => {
+   if (!wasabiClient) {
+     console.error('Wasabi client not initialized');
+     return false;
+   }
+   
+   try {
+     const command = new DeleteObjectCommand({
+       Bucket: wasabiConfig.bucketName,
+       Key: path,
+     });
+     
+     await wasabiClient.send(command);
+     return true;
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error deleting file from Wasabi:', error);
+     return false;
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ export default {
+   uploadFile,
+   getSignedFileUrl,
+   deleteFile,
+ }; 
```

Great! You've now set up Wasabi storage integration for your MeetNow application. Here's a summary of what we did:

1. Created a wasabi-storage.js utility module with functions for file upload/retrieval
2. Updated the meetup.js file to use Wasabi for image storage instead of Supabase storage
3. Added AWS SDK dependencies for S3 compatibility
4. Added environment variables for Wasabi configuration

**Next steps:**

1. Replace the placeholder values in your `.env` file with your actual Wasabi credentials
2. In your Wasabi account, make sure your bucket allows public read access for images
3. Set the CORS configuration in your Wasabi bucket to allow uploads from your application domain

To set CORS on your Wasabi bucket, use the Wasabi console or run this command with the AWS CLI (after configuring it with your Wasabi credentials):

```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket meetnow-images --cors-configuration '{
  "CORSRules": [
    {
      "AllowedOrigins": ["*"],
      "AllowedMethods": ["GET", "PUT", "POST", "DELETE"],
      "AllowedHeaders": ["*"],
      "MaxAgeSeconds": 3000
    }
  ]
}' --endpoint-url=https://s3.us-east-1.wasabisys.com
```

For production, replace the wildcard origins with your actual domain.

+ import { uploadFile, getSignedFileUrl, deleteFile } from './wasabi-storage';

+ /**
+  * Test function to verify Wasabi bucket connectivity
+  * This uploads a small test file, attempts to get a URL for it, and then deletes it
+  */
+ export const testWasabiBucket = async () => {
+   console.log('⏳ Testing Wasabi bucket connection...');
+   
+   try {
+     // Create a small test file
+     const testBlob = new Blob(['This is a test file for MeetNow Wasabi integration'], 
+       { type: 'text/plain' });
+     const testFile = new File([testBlob], 'wasabi-test.txt', { type: 'text/plain' });
+     
+     // Test path
+     const testPath = `test/wasabi-test-${Date.now()}.txt`;
+     
+     console.log(`Attempting to upload test file to: ${testPath}`);
+     
+     // Try uploading the file
+     const { success, url, error } = await uploadFile(testFile, testPath);
+     
+     if (!success || error) {
+       console.error('❌ Wasabi upload test failed:', error);
+       return { success: false, error: error?.message || 'Upload failed' };
+     }
+     
+     console.log(`✅ Upload successful! File available at: ${url}`);
+     
+     // Test getting a signed URL
+     console.log('Testing signed URL generation...');
+     const signedUrl = await getSignedFileUrl(testPath);
+     
+     if (!signedUrl) {
+       console.error('❌ Failed to generate signed URL');
+     } else {
+       console.log(`✅ Signed URL generated successfully: ${signedUrl}`);
+     }
+     
+     // Clean up by deleting the test file
+     console.log('Cleaning up test file...');
+     const deleteSuccess = await deleteFile(testPath);
+     
+     if (deleteSuccess) {
+       console.log('✅ Test file deleted successfully');
+     } else {
+       console.log('⚠️ Could not delete test file. It may need manual cleanup.');
+     }
+     
+     return { 
+       success: true, 
+       message: 'Wasabi bucket test completed successfully!',
+       uploadUrl: url,
+       signedUrl: signedUrl
+     };
+   } catch (err) {
+     console.error('❌ Wasabi test error:', err);
+     return { 
+       success: false, 
+       error: err.message || 'Unknown error during Wasabi test' 
+     };
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ export default testWasabiBucket;

+         
+         {testResults && (
+           <div className={`mt-4 p-4 rounded ${testResults.success ? 'bg-green-100' : 'bg-red-100'}`}>
+             <h3 className="font-semibold">
+               {testResults.success ? '✅ Test Successful!' : '❌ Test Failed'}
+             </h3>
+             
+             {testResults.success ? (
+               <div className="mt-2">
+                 <p>The Wasabi bucket is properly configured.</p>
+                 {testResults.uploadUrl && (
+                   <p className="mt-2">
+                     <strong>Upload URL:</strong> <br />
+                     <a 
+                       href={testResults.uploadUrl} 
+                       target="_blank" 
+                       rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                       className="text-blue-500 break-all"
+                     >
+                       {testResults.uploadUrl}
+                     </a>
+                   </p>
+                 )}
+                 {testResults.signedUrl && (
+                   <p className="mt-2">
+                     <strong>Signed URL:</strong> <br />
+                     <a 
+                       href={testResults.signedUrl} 
+                       target="_blank" 
+                       rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                       className="text-blue-500 break-all"
+                     >
+                       {testResults.signedUrl}
+                     </a>
+                   </p>
+                 )}
+               </div>
+             ) : (
+               <p className="mt-2 text-red-600">
+                 {testResults.error || 'Unknown error occurred'}
+               </p>
+             )}
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </div>
+       
+       <div className="border-t pt-6">
+         <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Bucket Configuration</h2>
+         <div className="bg-gray-100 p-3 rounded text-sm font-mono">
+           <p><strong>Region:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_REGION}</p>
+           <p><strong>Endpoint:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_ENDPOINT}</p>
+           <p><strong>Bucket:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_BUCKET_NAME}</p>
+           <p><strong>Access Key ID:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_ACCESS_KEY_ID ? '✅ Set' : '❌ Missing'}</p>
+           <p><strong>Secret Key:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY ? '✅ Set' : '❌ Missing'}</p>
+         </div>
+       </div>
+       
+       <div className="border-t pt-6 mt-6">
+         <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Test Image Upload</h2>
+         <p className="text-gray-600 mb-4">
+           You can test uploading an image file to the Wasabi bucket.
+         </p>
+         
+         <input 
+           type="file" 
+           accept="image/*" 
+           onChange={handleFileChange}
+           className="mb-4"
+         />
+         
+         {previewUrl && (
+           <div className="mt-4">
+             <h3 className="font-semibold mb-2">Image Preview:</h3>
+             <img 
+               src={previewUrl} 
+               alt="Preview" 
+               className="max-w-full h-auto max-h-64 rounded border"
+             />
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default WasabiTest;

Let's create a dedicated test page for running Wasabi tests:

---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { useState } from 'react';
+ import { uploadFile, getSignedFileUrl, deleteFile } from '../utils/wasabi-storage';
+ import { testWasabiBucket } from '../utils/wasabi-test';
+ 
+ function WasabiTestPage() {
+   const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState(null);
+   const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
+   const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null);
+   const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null);
+   const [uploadResult, setUploadResult] = useState(null);
+   const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
+ 
+   const runTest = async () => {
+     setTesting(true);
+     setTestResults(null);
+     
+     try {
+       const results = await testWasabiBucket();
+       setTestResults(results);
+     } catch (error) {
+       setTestResults({
+         success: false,
+         error: error.message || 'Unknown error during testing'
+       });
+     } finally {
+       setTesting(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleFileChange = (e) => {
+     const file = e.target.files[0];
+     if (file) {
+       setImageFile(file);
+       const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
+       setPreviewUrl(previewUrl);
+       setUploadResult(null); // Reset previous upload results
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const uploadImage = async () => {
+     if (!imageFile) {
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     setUploading(true);
+     setUploadResult(null);
+ 
+     try {
+       // Generate a unique path
+       const timestamp = Date.now();
+       const extension = imageFile.name.split('.').pop();
+       const filePath = `test/test-upload-${timestamp}.${extension}`;
+ 
+       // Upload the file
+       const result = await uploadFile(imageFile, filePath);
+       
+       if (!result.success) {
+         throw new Error(result.error || 'Upload failed');
+       }
+ 
+       setUploadResult({
+         success: true,
+         url: result.url,
+         message: 'Image uploaded successfully!'
+       });
+     } catch (error) {
+       setUploadResult({
+         success: false,
+         error: error.message || 'Failed to upload image'
+       });
+     } finally {
+       setUploading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto p-6 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md mt-8">
+       <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
+         <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Wasabi Storage Test</h1>
+         <a href="/" className="text-blue-500 hover:underline">Back to app</a>
+       </div>
+ 
+       <div className="bg-blue-50 p-4 rounded-md mb-6">
+         <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">Your Configuration</h2>
+         <ul className="space-y-1">
+           <li><strong>Bucket Name:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_BUCKET_NAME || 'Not configured'}</li>
+           <li><strong>Region:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_REGION || 'Not configured'}</li>
+           <li><strong>Endpoint:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_ENDPOINT || 'Not configured'}</li>
+           <li><strong>Access Key ID:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_ACCESS_KEY_ID ? '✅ Set' : '❌ Missing'}</li>
+           <li><strong>Secret Key:</strong> {import.meta.env.VITE_WASABI_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY ? '✅ Set' : '❌ Missing'}</li>
+         </ul>
+       </div>
+ 
+       <div className="mb-8 border-b pb-6">
+         <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Test Bucket Connection</h2>
+         <p className="mb-4 text-gray-600">
+           This will test the connection to your Wasabi bucket by uploading a small test file,
+           getting a signed URL, and then deleting the file.
+         </p>
+         
+         <button
+           className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-md ${testing ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed' : 'bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600'} text-white transition-colors`}
+           onClick={runTest}
+           disabled={testing}
+         >
+           {testing ? 'Testing...' : 'Run Bucket Test'}
+         </button>
+ 
+         {testResults && (
+           <div className={`mt-4 p-4 rounded-md ${testResults.success ? 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200' : 'bg-red-50 border border-red-200'}`}>
+             <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg mb-2">
+               {testResults.success ? '✅ Test Successful' : '❌ Test Failed'}
+             </h3>
+             
+             {testResults.success ? (
+               <div>
+                 <p className="mb-2">{testResults.message}</p>
+                 
+                 {testResults.uploadUrl && (
+                   <p className="mb-2">
+                     <strong>Upload URL:</strong><br />
+                     <a 
+                       href={testResults.uploadUrl} 
+                       target="_blank" 
+                       rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                       className="text-blue-500 break-all hover:underline"
+                     >
+                       {testResults.uploadUrl}
+                     </a>
+                   </p>
+                 )}
+                 
+                 {testResults.signedUrl && (
+                   <p>
+                     <strong>Signed URL:</strong><br />
+                     <a 
+                       href={testResults.signedUrl} 
+                       target="_blank" 
+                       rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                       className="text-blue-500 break-all hover:underline"
+                     >
+                       {testResults.signedUrl}
+                     </a>
+                   </p>
+                 )}
+               </div>
+             ) : (
+               <p className="text-red-600">{testResults.error}</p>
+             )}
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </div>
+ 
+       <div>
+         <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Test Image Upload</h2>
+         <p className="mb-4 text-gray-600">
+           Upload an image file to test your Wasabi storage configuration.
+         </p>
+ 
+         <input 
+           type="file" 
+           accept="image/*" 
+           onChange={handleFileChange}
+           className="mb-4"
+         />
+ 
+         {previewUrl && (
+           <div className="mt-4">
+             <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 border rounded-md mb-4">
+               <h3 className="font-semibold mb-2">Image Preview:</h3>
+               <img 
+                 src={previewUrl} 
+                 alt="Preview" 
+                 className="max-w-full h-auto max-h-64 rounded-md"
+               />
+             </div>
+ 
+             <button
+               className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-md ${uploading ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed' : 'bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600'} text-white transition-colors`}
+               onClick={uploadImage}
+               disabled={uploading}
+             >
+               {uploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'Upload Image'}
+             </button>
+ 
+             {uploadResult && (
+               <div className={`mt-4 p-4 rounded-md ${uploadResult.success ? 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200' : 'bg-red-50 border border-red-200'}`}>
+                 <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg mb-2">
+                   {uploadResult.success ? '✅ Upload Successful' : '❌ Upload Failed'}
+                 </h3>
+                 
+                 {uploadResult.success ? (
+                   <div>
+                     <p className="mb-2">{uploadResult.message}</p>
+                     
+                     {uploadResult.url && (
+                       <>
+                         <p className="mb-2">
+                           <strong>Image URL:</strong><br />
+                           <a 
+                             href={uploadResult.url} 
+                             target="_blank" 
+                             rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                             className="text-blue-500 break-all hover:underline"
+                           >
+                             {uploadResult.url}
+                           </a>
+                         </p>
+                         
+                         <div className="mt-4 bg-gray-50 p-4 border rounded-md">
+                           <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">Uploaded Image:</h4>
+                           <img 
+                             src={uploadResult.url} 
+                             alt="Uploaded" 
+                             className="max-w-full h-auto max-h-64 rounded-md"
+                           />
+                         </div>
+                       </>
+                     )}
+                   </div>
+                 ) : (
+                   <p className="text-red-600">{uploadResult.error}</p>
+                 )}
+               </div>
+             )}
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ export default WasabiTestPage; 
```

Now I'll create a `CountdownTimer` component that we can use in the popup. First, I'll create the component:

---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
+ 
+ /**
+  * Countdown timer component with ASCII spinners
+  * 
+  * @param {Object} props
+  * @param {Date|string} props.expiryTime - The time when the countdown expires
+  * @param {Date|string} props.startTime - The time when the countdown starts
+  * @param {number} props.durationMinutes - Duration in minutes (alternative to expiryTime)
+  */
+ const CountdownTimer = ({ expiryTime, startTime, durationMinutes }) => {
+   const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState({ hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 });
+   const [spinnerIndex, setSpinnerIndex] = useState(0);
+   const [percentLeft, setPercentLeft] = useState(100);
+   
+   // Array of ASCII spinner characters
+   const spinners = ['⠋', '⠙', '⠹', '⠸', '⠼', '⠴', '⠦', '⠧', '⠇', '⠏'];
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     // Convert inputs to Date objects if they're not already
+     let expiry;
+     
+     if (expiryTime) {
+       expiry = expiryTime instanceof Date ? expiryTime : new Date(expiryTime);
+     } else if (startTime && durationMinutes) {
+       expiry = startTime instanceof Date ? new Date(startTime) : new Date(startTime);
+       expiry.setMinutes(expiry.getMinutes() + durationMinutes);
+     } else {
+       // Default: 1 hour from now
+       expiry = new Date();
+       expiry.setHours(expiry.getHours() + 1);
+     }
+     
+     // Update countdown every second
+     const timer = setInterval(() => {
+       const now = new Date();
+       const diff = expiry - now;
+       
+       // Calculate total duration in ms
+       let totalDuration;
+       if (startTime && durationMinutes) {
+         const start = startTime instanceof Date ? startTime : new Date(startTime);
+         totalDuration = durationMinutes * 60 * 1000;
+         const elapsed = now - start;
+         const remaining = totalDuration - elapsed;
+         setPercentLeft(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (remaining / totalDuration) * 100)));
+       } else {
+         // Default 1-hour duration if no specific duration is given
+         totalDuration = 60 * 60 * 1000;
+         setPercentLeft(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (diff / totalDuration) * 100)));
+       }
+       
+       if (diff <= 0) {
+         // Countdown finished
+         setCountdown({ hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 });
+         clearInterval(timer);
+         return;
+       }
+       
+       // Calculate hours, minutes, seconds
+       const hours = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
+       const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
+       const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
+       
+       setCountdown({ hours, minutes, seconds });
+       
+       // Update spinner
+       setSpinnerIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % spinners.length);
+     }, 1000);
+     
+     return () => clearInterval(timer);
+   }, [expiryTime, startTime, durationMinutes]);
+   
+   // Format the countdown with padding to ensure consistent width
+   const formatTime = (value) => value.toString().padStart(2, '0');
+   
+   // Current spinner character
+   const spinner = spinners[spinnerIndex];
+   
+   return (
+     <div className="countdown-timer text-center mt-2 font-mono">
+       <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
+         <span className="mr-2">{spinner}</span>
+         <span className="countdown-text">
+           {formatTime(countdown.hours)}:{formatTime(countdown.minutes)}:{formatTime(countdown.seconds)}
+         </span>
+         <span className="ml-2">{spinner}</span>
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ CountdownTimer.propTypes = {
+   expiryTime: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
+   startTime: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
+   durationMinutes: PropTypes.number
+ };
+ 
+ export default CountdownTimer; 
```

# Wasabi Bucket Policies for Anonymous Uploads and Viewing

Yes, I can help you set up Wasabi bucket policies for anonymous users to upload and view photos. Here's how you can configure it:

## 1. Create a Public Read Policy

First, you'll need to enable public read access for viewing the photos:

```json
{
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Sid": "PublicRead",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": "*",
            "Action": [
                "s3:GetObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
                "arn:aws:s3:::your-bucket-name/*"
            ]
        }
    ]
}
```

## 2. Configure CORS Policy for Uploads

To allow browser-based uploads from your domain, you'll need a CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) policy:

```json
[
    {
        "AllowedHeaders": [
            "*"
        ],
        "AllowedMethods": [
            "PUT",
            "POST",
            "GET"
        ],
        "AllowedOrigins": [
            "https://yourdomain.com"
        ],
        "ExposeHeaders": [
            "ETag"
        ],
        "MaxAgeSeconds": 3000
    }
]
```

## 3. For Anonymous Uploads

For anonymous uploads, you have two main approaches:

### Option A: Pre-signed URLs (Recommended)

This is more secure. Your server generates temporary upload URLs with an expiration time:

1. Create an API endpoint in your backend that generates pre-signed URLs
2. When a user wants to upload a photo, call this endpoint
3. Use the returned URL to upload directly from the browser

```javascript
// Server-side code example
import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-s3";
import { getSignedUrl } from "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner";

const s3Client = new S3Client({
  region: "us-east-1", // Wasabi region
  endpoint: "https://s3.wasabisys.com", // Wasabi endpoint
  credentials: {
    accessKeyId: "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY",
    secretAccessKey: "YOUR_SECRET_KEY"
  }
});

// Generate a pre-signed URL valid for 5 minutes
const getUploadUrl = async (meetupId, fileName) => {
  const key = `meetups/${meetupId}/${fileName}`;
  const command = new PutObjectCommand({
    Bucket: "your-bucket-name",
    Key: key,
    ContentType: "image/jpeg" // Or appropriate type
  });
  
  const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3Client, command, { 
    expiresIn: 300 // 5 minutes
  });
  
  return {
    uploadUrl: signedUrl,
    publicUrl: `https://your-bucket-name.s3.wasabisys.com/${key}`
  };
};
```

### Option B: Direct Policy-Based Uploads

If you need completely anonymous uploads without any server interaction:

```json
{
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Sid": "AllowAnonymousUploadsToSpecificPath",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": "*",
            "Action": [
                "s3:PutObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
                "arn:aws:s3:::your-bucket-name/meetups/*"
            ],
            "Condition": {
                "StringLike": {
                    "s3:x-amz-content-type": "image/*"
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
```

This is less secure but simpler. I'd recommend using pre-signed URLs instead for better security.

## 4. Implementation Tips

1. Use unique paths for each meetup (e.g., `meetups/{meetupId}/{timestamp}-{filename}`)
2. Consider adding size limits for uploaded files
3. Validate file types on both client and server
4. If using pre-signed URLs, implement proper authentication for the API endpoint

# Setting Up CORS Policy for Local Development

You can configure CORS for your Wasabi bucket to work with your local development environment by including `localhost` entries in your allowed origins. Here's how to do it:

## CORS Policy for Local Development

```json
[
    {
        "AllowedHeaders": [
            "*"
        ],
        "AllowedMethods": [
            "PUT",
            "POST",
            "GET",
            "DELETE"
        ],
        "AllowedOrigins": [
            "http://localhost:3000",
            "http://localhost:5173",
            "http://127.0.0.1:3000",
            "http://127.0.0.1:5173"
        ],
        "ExposeHeaders": [
            "ETag"
        ],
        "MaxAgeSeconds": 3000
    }
]
```

## Implementation Notes:

1. **Include multiple localhost ports**: I've included ports 3000 and 5173 since these are common for React and Vite development servers. If your app uses a different port, add that instead.

2. **Include both localhost and 127.0.0.1**: Some frameworks access via `localhost` while others use the IP address directly.

3. **Test after configuration**: After setting this policy, wait a few minutes for the changes to propagate before testing.

4. **Update later**: When you deploy to production, you'll want to update this policy to include your actual domain.

## How to Apply the CORS Policy in Wasabi

1. Login to your Wasabi console
2. Navigate to your bucket
3. Select "Properties" or "Permissions" (depending on the interface)
4. Find the CORS configuration section
5. Paste the JSON policy above
6. Save changes

This will enable your local development environment to interact with your Wasabi bucket for both uploads and downloads until you deploy to a permanent domain.

# Resolving Wasabi Public Access Permissions Issue

That error message ("The following policy items are not available to you: Public Access") typically appears when account-level restrictions are preventing you from making your bucket publicly accessible. This is often a security feature implemented by Wasabi.

## Possible Causes and Solutions:

### 1. Account-Level Block Public Access Setting

Wasabi, like AWS S3, has account-level settings that can block public access regardless of bucket policies.

**Solution:**
- Login to your Wasabi account management console
- Look for "Block Public Access settings" or "Account Settings"
- Disable the account-level public access blocking
- Note: This might require account owner/admin permissions

### 2. Bucket Policy Format Issues

Sometimes the error occurs when there's a syntax issue with your policy.

**Solution:**
Try using this exact format for your bucket policy:

```json
{
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Sid": "PublicReadGetObject",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": "*",
            "Action": "s3:GetObject",
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::YOUR-BUCKET-NAME/*"
        }
    ]
}
```

Replace "YOUR-BUCKET-NAME" with your actual bucket name.

### 3. Account Tier Restrictions

Some Wasabi account tiers might restrict public access capabilities for security reasons.

**Solution:**
- Contact Wasabi support to verify if your account tier allows public bucket access
- They may need to enable this feature for your account

### 4. Alternative Approach: Pre-signed URLs

If you can't enable public access, you can still provide temporary access:

```javascript
// Generate pre-signed URLs for each image
// These work even when the bucket isn't public
function getImageUrl(key) {
  // Server-side code to generate a pre-signed URL with expiration
  // Return a URL that works for a limited time without making the bucket public
}
```

This approach allows you to control access without making the entire bucket public.

Now let's implement the pre-signed URL approach. I notice there's already a `getSignedFileUrl` function for retrieving files, but we need one for uploading files. I'll create a new function for generating pre-signed upload URLs:

---

```diff
  
  /**
-  * Upload a file to Wasabi
+  * Generate a pre-signed URL for file upload
+  * This allows client-side uploads without making the bucket public
+  * 
+  * @param {string} path - The destination path/key in the bucket
+  * @param {string} contentType - The MIME type of the file to be uploaded
+  * @param {number} expiresIn - Expiration time in seconds (default: 300 - 5 minutes)
+  * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, uploadUrl: string|null, publicUrl: string|null, error: Error|null}>}
+  */
+ export const getUploadPresignedUrl = async (path, contentType, expiresIn = 300) => {
+   if (!wasabiClient) {
+     return { 
+       success: false, 
+       uploadUrl: null, 
+       publicUrl: null, 
+       error: new Error('Wasabi client not initialized') 
+     };
+   }
+   
+   try {
+     // Generate a unique path if not provided
+     if (!path) {
+       const timestamp = Date.now();
+       const extension = contentType.split('/')[1] || 'file';
+       path = `meetups/meetup_${timestamp}.${extension}`;
+     }
+     
+     // Prepare the command for generating a signed URL
+     const command = new PutObjectCommand({
+       Bucket: wasabiConfig.bucketName,
+       Key: path,
+       ContentType: contentType,
+     });
+     
+     // Generate the pre-signed URL
+     const uploadUrl = await getSignedUrl(wasabiClient, command, { expiresIn });
+     
+     // Generate the future public URL for reference after upload
+     const publicUrl = `https://${wasabiConfig.bucketName}.${wasabiConfig.endpoint.replace('https://', '')}/${path}`;
+     
+     return { 
+       success: true, 
+       uploadUrl, 
+       publicUrl, 
+       error: null 
+     };
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error generating pre-signed upload URL:', error);
+     return { 
+       success: false, 
+       uploadUrl: null, 
+       publicUrl: null, 
+       error 
+     };
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Modify the existing uploadFile function to use pre-signed URLs when needed
   * @param {File} file - The file to upload
   * @param {string} path - The path/key in the bucket (e.g., 'meetups/image1.jpg')
+  * @param {boolean} usePreSignedUrl - Whether to use pre-signed URL approach (default: true)
   * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, url: string|null, error: Error|null}>}
   */
- export const uploadFile = async (file, path) => {
+ export const uploadFile = async (file, path, usePreSignedUrl = true) => {
+   // If we're using pre-signed URLs, generate one and return it
+   if (usePreSignedUrl) {
+     try {
+       // Generate a unique path if not provided
+       if (!path) {
+         const timestamp = Date.now();
+         const extension = file.name.split('.').pop();
+         path = `meetups/meetup_${timestamp}.${extension}`;
+       }
+       
+       // Get a pre-signed URL for this upload
+       const { success, uploadUrl, publicUrl, error } = await getUploadPresignedUrl(path, file.type);
+       
+       if (!success || !uploadUrl) {
+         return { success: false, url: null, error: error || new Error('Failed to generate upload URL') };
+       }
+       
+       // Perform the upload using fetch with the pre-signed URL
+       const response = await fetch(uploadUrl, {
+         method: 'PUT',
+         body: file,
+         headers: {
+           'Content-Type': file.type,
+         },
+       });
+       
+       if (!response.ok) {
+         throw new Error(`Upload failed with status: ${response.status}`);
+       }
+       
+       return { success: true, url: publicUrl, error: null };
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Error uploading via pre-signed URL:', error);
+       return { success: false, url: null, error };
+     }
+   }
+   
+   // Original direct upload implementation (when not using pre-signed URLs)
    if (!wasabiClient) {
      return { success: false, url: null, error: new Error('Wasabi client not initialized') };
    uploadFile,
    getSignedFileUrl,
+   getUploadPresignedUrl,
    deleteFile,
  };

Let's implement a meetup image uploader component that utilizes our pre-signed URL approach:

---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { useState } from 'react';
+ import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
+ import { getUploadPresignedUrl } from '../utils/wasabi-storage';
+ import { FaImage, FaUpload, FaTimes, FaCheck } from 'react-icons/fa';
+ 
+ /**
+  * Component for uploading images to meetup cards using pre-signed URLs
+  * 
+  * @param {Object} props
+  * @param {Function} props.onImageUploaded - Callback when image is uploaded successfully
+  * @param {string} props.meetupId - Meetup ID (for filename generation)
+  * @param {string} props.className - Additional CSS classes
+  */
+ const MeetupImageUploader = ({ onImageUploaded, meetupId, className = '' }) => {
+   const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState(null);
+   const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
+   const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
+   const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState(null); // 'success', 'error', or null
+   const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
+   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
+ 
+   // Handle file selection
+   const handleFileChange = (e) => {
+     const file = e.target.files[0];
+     if (!file) return;
+ 
+     // Reset states
+     setError(null);
+     setUploadStatus(null);
+     setUploadProgress(0);
+     
+     // Validate file type and size
+     const validTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp'];
+     if (!validTypes.includes(file.type)) {
+       setError('Please select a valid image file (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP)');
+       return;
+     }
+     
+     // Max 5MB
+     const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
+     if (file.size > maxSize) {
+       setError('Image is too large. Maximum size is 5MB.');
+       return;
+     }
+     
+     // Set the selected file and generate preview
+     setSelectedFile(file);
+     
+     // Create preview URL
+     const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
+     setPreview(previewUrl);
+   };
+   
+   // Handle image upload
+   const handleUpload = async () => {
+     if (!selectedFile) {
+       setError('Please select an image first');
+       return;
+     }
+     
+     try {
+       setUploading(true);
+       setUploadProgress(10);
+       setError(null);
+       
+       // Generate a unique path for the image
+       const timestamp = Date.now();
+       const fileId = meetupId || `anonymous_${timestamp}`;
+       const extension = selectedFile.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
+       const filename = `meetup_${fileId}_${timestamp}.${extension}`;
+       const filePath = `meetups/${filename}`;
+       
+       // Get a pre-signed URL for uploading
+       setUploadProgress(30);
+       const { success, uploadUrl, publicUrl, error } = await getUploadPresignedUrl(
+         filePath, 
+         selectedFile.type
+       );
+       
+       if (!success || !uploadUrl) {
+         throw new Error(error?.message || 'Failed to generate upload URL');
+       }
+       
+       // Upload the file using the pre-signed URL
+       setUploadProgress(50);
+       const response = await fetch(uploadUrl, {
+         method: 'PUT',
+         body: selectedFile,
+         headers: {
+           'Content-Type': selectedFile.type,
+         }
+       });
+       
+       if (!response.ok) {
+         throw new Error(`Upload failed with status: ${response.status}`);
+       }
+       
+       // Success!
+       setUploadProgress(100);
+       setUploadStatus('success');
+       
+       // Call the callback with the public URL
+       if (onImageUploaded) {
+         onImageUploaded(publicUrl);
+       }
+       
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error('Error uploading image:', err);
+       setError(err.message || 'Failed to upload image');
+       setUploadStatus('error');
+     } finally {
+       setUploading(false);
+     }
+   };
+   
+   // Handle cancellation
+   const handleCancel = () => {
+     setSelectedFile(null);
+     setPreview(null);
+     setUploadStatus(null);
+     setUploadProgress(0);
+     setError(null);
+   };
+   
+   return (
+     <div className={`meetup-image-uploader ${className}`}>
+       {/* Image Preview */}
+       {preview && (
+         <div className="preview-container relative mb-3">
+           <img 
+             src={preview} 
+             alt="Preview" 
+             className="w-full h-32 object-cover rounded-md"
+           />
+           <button 
+             onClick={handleCancel}
+             className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-red-500 text-white p-1 rounded-full"
+             title="Remove image"
+           >
+             <FaTimes />
+           </button>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       
+       {/* File Input */}
+       {!preview && (
+         <div className="file-input-container">
+           <label className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-4 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:border-blue-500 cursor-pointer bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
+             <FaImage className="text-gray-500" />
+             <span className="text-gray-700">Select Image</span>
+             <input
+               type="file"
+               accept="image/*"
+               onChange={handleFileChange}
+               className="hidden"
+             />
+           </label>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       
+       {/* Upload Button */}
+       {selectedFile && !uploadStatus && (
+         <button
+           onClick={handleUpload}
+           disabled={uploading}
+           className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-2 px-4 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-blue-300 transition-colors"
+         >
+           {uploading ? (
+             <>
+               <div className="spinner mr-2"></div>
+               <span>{Math.round(uploadProgress)}%</span>
+             </>
+           ) : (
+             <>
+               <FaUpload />
+               <span>Upload Image</span>
+             </>
+           )}
+         </button>
+       )}
+       
+       {/* Upload Status */}
+       {uploadStatus === 'success' && (
+         <div className="mt-2 flex items-center text-green-600">
+           <FaCheck className="mr-2" />
+           <span>Upload successful!</span>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       
+       {/* Error Message */}
+       {error && (
+         <div className="mt-2 text-red-500 text-sm">
+           {error}
+         </div>
+       )}
+       
+       {/* Upload Progress Bar */}
+       {uploading && (
+         <div className="mt-2 w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2.5">
+           <div
+             className="bg-blue-600 h-2.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
+             style={{ width: `${uploadProgress}%` }}
+           ></div>
+         </div>
+       )}

    }

+ /**
+  * Update a meetup's image
+  * 
+  * @param {string} meetupId - The ID of the meetup to update
+  * @param {string} imageUrl - The URL of the uploaded image
+  * @returns {Promise<Object>} Result object with success/error info
+  */
+ export const updateMeetupImage = async (meetupId, imageUrl) => {
+   try {
+     console.log(`Updating meetup ${meetupId} with image URL: ${imageUrl}`);
+     
+     if (!meetupId || !imageUrl) {
+       throw new Error('Meetup ID and image URL are required');
+     }
+     
+     // Ensure user is logged in
+     const { data: session } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
+     if (!session?.session?.user) {
+       throw new Error('You must be logged in to update a meetup');
+     }
+     
+     // Update the meetup with the new image URL
+     const { data, error } = await supabase
+       .from('meetups')
+       .update({ 
+         image_url: imageUrl,
+         updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
+       })
+       .eq('id', meetupId)
+       .select('id, image_url');
+     
+     if (error) {
+       console.error('Error updating meetup image:', error);
+       throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to update meetup image');
+     }
+     
+     if (!data || data.length === 0) {
+       throw new Error('Meetup not found or you do not have permission to update it');
+     }
+     
+     return {
+       success: true,
+       meetup: data[0]
+     };
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error in updateMeetupImage:', error);
+     return {
+       success: false,
+       error: error.message || 'Failed to update meetup image'
+     };
+   }
+ };

# Reflecting on Our Implementation: Pre-signed URLs for Wasabi Storage

Let me summarize the approach we've taken to enable secure image uploads without making your Wasabi bucket public:

## What We've Accomplished

1. **Pre-signed URL Implementation**
   - Added a `getUploadPresignedUrl` function to generate temporary upload URLs
   - Modified the `uploadFile` function to use pre-signed URLs by default
   - Built a client-side upload solution that doesn't require changing bucket permissions

     - File selection and preview

     - Upload progress indication

   - Connected the front-end uploader to the backend

## Benefits of This Approach

- **Security**: The bucket remains private while still allowing specific uploads
- **Granular Control**: Each upload permission is distinct and time-limited
- **User Experience**: Clean interface with feedback throughout the upload process
- **Flexibility**: Works for both anonymous and authenticated users

## Next Steps

2. **Error Handling**: Add more robust error messaging for users
3. **UI Refinement**: Consider adding loading states to the meetup cards when images are updated

# Setting Anonymous User IDs in Meetup Creation

Yes, we can modify the meetup creation flow to leave the user ID as null by default. This approach has several advantages:

1. **Anonymous Accessibility**: Anyone can create a meetup without registration
2. **Optional Authentication**: Users can choose to register later and claim their meetups
3. **Clear Distinction**: Easy to identify which meetups are from registered users

## Implementation Steps

### 1. Modify the Meetup Creation Function

In your `meetup.js` utility file, update the `createFreeMeetup` or similar function:

```javascript:src/utils/meetup.js
// ... existing code ...

export const createFreeMeetup = async (meetupData) => {
  try {
    // Instead of requiring a user ID, make it optional
    const { data: session } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    const userId = session?.user?.id || null; // Will be null for anonymous users
    
    // Prepare meetup data with optional user ID
    const preparedData = {
      ...meetupData,
      user_id: userId, // This will be null for anonymous users
      // Add other default properties if needed
      anonymous_created: userId ? false : true, // Flag to track anonymous creation
      meetup_token: userId ? null : generateMeetupToken() // Generate a unique token for anonymous users
    };
    
    // Rest of your function
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('create_meetup', {
      p_title: preparedData.title,
      p_description: preparedData.description,
      p_address: preparedData.address, 
      p_lat: preparedData.lat,
      p_lng: preparedData.lng,
      p_image: preparedData.image_url || null,
      p_user_id: preparedData.user_id, // Can be null
      p_duration_minutes: preparedData.duration_minutes,
      p_meetup_token: preparedData.meetup_token // For anonymous users to edit later
    });
    
    // ...
  } catch (error) {
    // ...
  }
};

// Helper function to generate a unique token for anonymous meetups
const generateMeetupToken = () => {
  return Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15) + 
         Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
};
```

### 2. Update the Database Function

If you're using a stored procedure in Supabase (like `create_meetup`), make sure it accepts null for the `p_user_id` parameter:

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_meetup(
  p_title TEXT,
  p_description TEXT,
  p_address TEXT,
  p_lat FLOAT8,
  p_lng FLOAT8,
  p_image TEXT,
  p_user_id UUID,  -- Note: This can be NULL now
  p_duration_minutes INTEGER,
  p_meetup_token TEXT
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Insert with potentially null user_id
  INSERT INTO public.meetups (
    title, description, address, lat, lng, 
    image_url, user_id, duration_minutes, meetup_token
  ) VALUES (
    p_title, p_description, p_address, p_lat, p_lng, 
    p_image, p_user_id, p_duration_minutes, p_meetup_token
  )
  RETURNING id, title, created_at;
  
  -- Rest of the function...
END;
$$;
```

In your meetup creation form, don't require users to be logged in:

### 4. Add Token-Based Editing for Anonymous Users

This approach requires a way for anonymous users to edit their meetups:

```javascript
// In your meetup edit functions
export const canEditMeetup = async (meetupId, meetupToken = null) => {
  // Check if the user is logged in
  const { data: session } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const userId = session?.user?.id;
  
  if (userId) {
    // For logged-in users, check if they own the meetup
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('meetups')
      .select('user_id')
      .eq('id', meetupId)
      .single();
      
    return data?.user_id === userId;
  } else if (meetupToken) {
    // For anonymous users, verify the token
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('meetups')
      .select('meetup_token')
      .eq('id', meetupId)
      .single();
      
    return data?.meetup_token === meetupToken;
  }
  
  return false;
};
```

This implementation allows anonymous users to create meetups while still giving them a way to manage their meetups through a unique token. Registered users will have their user_id linked to their meetups as before.
